description: Source code implementing the FunctionSchema class and related functions for handling function signatures, argument types, aliasing, and schema compatibility in the ATen library of PyTorch.

classes.name: FunctionSchema
classes.description: Represents the schema of a function, including its name, arguments, return types, and compatibility checks.

classes.name: Argument
classes.description: Represents a function argument, including its name, type, default value, and aliasing info.

methods.name: dump
methods.description: Prints the schema to standard output.

methods.name: getCorrectList
methods.description: Returns the list of arguments or returns based on the SchemaArgType.

methods.name: cloneWithRealTypes
methods.description: Creates a clone of the schema with argument types replaced by their real types, optionally handling SymInt types.

methods.name: canAliasTypeSetsAlias
methods.description: Checks if two alias type sets can alias each other.

methods.name: getAliasTypeSetContainedTypes
methods.description: Returns the contained types within an alias type set.

methods.name: mapTypeToAliasTypeSet
methods.description: Maps a type to its corresponding alias type set.

methods.name: may_alias
methods.description: Determines if two schema arguments may alias.

methods.name: may_contain_alias
methods.description: Checks if two schema arguments may contain aliasing, considering bidirectionality.

methods.name: formatTypeMismatchMsg
methods.description: Formats an error message for type mismatches.

methods.name: isBackwardCompatibleWith
methods.description: Checks if the current schema is backward compatible with an old schema.

methods.name: isForwardCompatibleWith
methods.description: Checks if the current schema is forward compatible with an old schema.

methods.name: findErrorInKwargs
methods.description: Finds errors related to keyword arguments.

methods.name: cloneWithRemappedTypes
methods.description: Creates a clone of the schema with argument types remapped.

methods.name: isSubtypeOf
methods.description: Checks if the current schema is a subtype of another schema.
